title: TeamBalance — Team Management for Sports Clubs
metaDescription: TeamBalance keeps team attendance and the shared team pot in one place, next to the group chat your team already uses.
metaImageAlt: TeamBalance: keep the chat, skip the scroll-back.
privacyDescription: What TeamBalance stores when you ask for a login link, why, for how long, and how to have it removed.
privacyIntro: This page lists what TeamBalance stores when you ask for a login link on this website. It is written from what the software does.
privacyStoredEmail: Your email address, together with a hash of the one-time login link we send you, and the time it was created and expires. We store the hash, not the link itself.
privacyStoredAccount: When you open the link, an account is created for your email address, with a display name taken from the part before the @. You can change it in the app.
privacyStoredIp: Your IP address is held in the memory of the server to limit how many login links one address can ask for (5 per minute). It is not written to the database and is dropped after an hour without requests.
privacyWhyLink: The email address is used to send the login link and to recognise you when you sign in. A login link works once and for 15 minutes.
privacyWhyRetention: The login link record stays in the database after it expires; there is no automatic clean-up yet. The account stays until you ask for removal.
privacyNoTracking: This website has no analytics and sets no tracking cookies. Fonts are served from teambalance.nl itself, so your browser contacts no font provider.
privacyRemoval: To have your data removed, or to ask what is stored about you, send an email to
heroTitle: Keep the chat. Skip the scroll-back.
heroSub: Your team chat is where the team talks, and it stays that way. TeamBalance answers who is coming to which training or match, so nobody has to scroll up and count.

introTitle: The chat stays. These move out of it.
introText: Some questions are easy to ask in a group chat and hard to answer by scrolling. Here is where each one gets answered.
rosterTitle: A roster for every event, by position
rosterText: Training and match each have their own list: who is going, who is not sure, who has not answered. It also shows whether there are enough players.
rosterOneTap: Away for a while? "Going to everything" answers all your open events in one tap.
askOwe: who still owes for the hall?
potText: The team's money sits in a real Bunq bank account. Members top up from their phone with a bunq.me link: €10, €20, €50 or an amount of their own.
potNote: There is no list of who owes what. The pot runs on trust.
potAlt: A pot holding the team's money: €184
potCaption: Example pot of a volleyball team
topupIdle: Pick an amount. It opens a bunq.me link on your phone.
topupPicked: Opens a bunq.me link on your phone for {amount}.
calText: Subscribe once. Every training and match shows up in your own calendar, with the right time.
askAdd: add my friend to the group
inviteText: Send the link to your team or a new member. Everyone logs in with a magic link sent to their email, so there are no passwords to forget.
askShort: we're one short, who knows someone?
subTitle: A substitute for one event
subText: Know someone who can fill in? Call them in for a single training or match. They do not have to join the team.
originTitle: It started with two volleyball teams.
originText: TeamBalance began as a hobby tool for two volleyball teams at Tovo Utrecht. It is still built for teams like that: amateur, friendly, and tired of scrolling.
closeSub: Enter your email and we send you a login link. Or look around the demo first.
